traceability.notes: The 006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION story is fully implemented as the traceability/valid-story-reference ESLint rule plus supporting utilities. The rule validates that @story annotations reference existing .story.md files, enforces extension and project-boundary constraints, supports configurable story directories and absolute-path behavior, and uses cached, exception-safe filesystem checks. Comprehensive tests explicitly tied to this story verify file existence handling, path resolution, security (traversal and absolute paths), project boundaries, configuration options, and robust error handling (including fileAccessError diagnostics for filesystem issues). Documentation in docs/rules/valid-story-reference.md describes behavior, options, and boundary semantics in line with the story’s acceptance criteria. All relevant tests pass under the current test run, so all listed requirements and acceptance criteria for this story are satisfied.
